metadata.method_limitations: Grad-CAM is a gradient-based localization explanation, not proof of causal feature importance. A zero heatmap means no positive response survived ReLU at this target layer.

asfr_gate.warning: The gate shows learned spatial gating values. It is not class-specific Grad-CAM and is not, by itself, evidence of causal feature importance.

metadata.interpretation: Learned ASFR spatial gating values; not Grad-CAM and not, by themselves, causal feature importance.
